title: AI cost-cutting not a legal excuse to fire workers, Chinese court says (SCMP)
notes: SCMP (top-tier), full article retrieved (2-min read). Supports: Hangzhou Intermediate Court illegal-termination ruling; Zhou (35, fintech QA supervisor) refused demotion+pay cut, fired for AI replacement; won arbitration/trial/appeal; >260,000 yuan (US$38,067) compensation; Judge Shi Guoqiang CCTV quote 'AI has not reached the point to substantially replace human workers'.
